integrity: The dated primary topology source is arXiv:1104.0433v1 (2011-04-03). The original Folkman graph is a 1967 construction with no exact verified calendar day used for metadata. A canonical n=5 finite computation corroborates, but does not replace, the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational group-module structure of the discrete vertex-set graph-metric persistence is classified; no equivariant homotopy equivalence or irreducible integral representation is asserted. The nonequivariant filtration of the undoubled subdivision and its scale-two Betti number are prior literature, not new claims.
title: Equivariant Rips persistence of subdivided doubles of complete graphs
